args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Note on the PHL label confusion:
- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (via Bettina Kroll)

args.text: Bettina, I saved the draft 'PHL label cleanup' to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com). It has the three original bullets from Sofia's note plus your two lines: Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. I left out the extra bullet I'd added to Sofia's channel post. It's a draft only, not sent.

Correction for Bettina: the draft has two of Sofia's original bullets, not three (the rename and the Covey — Late Arrivals report), plus your two Pellucid and Pellow lines. The extra third bullet is not in it.

Bettina, the draft "PHL label cleanup" is saved to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com). It is not sent. I wrongly said earlier that it had three of Sofia's bullets. It has two, and I posted a correction in #coastal-team.
